To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the data mining techniques can identify proteomic patterns with a reasonably high detection performance, and that the pattern selection and the classification efficiency are highly dependent upon the selection method used.
data mining techniques can effectively identify proteomic patterns that discriminate cancer from normal with a reasonably high accuracy.
data mining techniques can effectively discriminate cancer from normal with a high performance and the discriminatory features can be very different depending on the data mining technique used.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the application of data analysis techniques to the identification of proteomic patterns that discriminate cancer from normal samples.
a novel data mining method for cancer detection using data from serum SELDI MS profiling.
the application of data-mining techniques in the field of proteomics for the purpose of cancer detection.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the use of data mining techniques is a viable approach to the discovery of cancer related proteins and the development of diagnostic/prognostic tools.
data mining techniques can successfully be used for cancer detection with a relatively high performance.
a combination of different feature selection methods can be used to improve the performance of cancer detection.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the data mining technique is a promising approach for proteomic profiling analysis and can be used as an effective tool for cancer detection/diagnostics.
data mining techniques can successfully be applied in cancer diagnosis and detection.
the data mining techniques are promising in the discovery of cancer biomarkers and the discrimination of cancer samples from non-cancer ones.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the data mining approach can be used to discover cancer related proteins from proteomic profiling and the results are highly classifier dependent.
a data mining based approach is an efficient method to identify proteomic patterns for cancer detection/diagnostics, but it should not be viewed as the sole method to identify cancer biomarkers.
data mining techniques can provide a powerful tool for cancer detection and diagnosis, and can be used as a complementary approach to traditional methods in proteomics.
